data.title: Shahar rivoji
data.subtitle: Present perfect passive va past perfect passive

narr: Endi shahar rivoji bilan bog'li mashqni ko'rib chiqaylik.
Bu erda biz present perfect passive va past perfect passive dan foydalanamiz.
Present perfect passive - bu boshlang'anidan beri hozirgacha davom etayotgan harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi.
Past perfect passive esa o'tminda, boshqa harakatdan oldin sodir bo'lgan harakatlar uchun qo'llaniladi.

data.heading: 5-mashq — Shahar rivoji
data.problem: Matnni qavsdagi fe'llarning present perfect passive yoki past perfect passive shakli bilan to'ldiring:
steps: a) In many countries in recent years, areas of urban land which were once used for industrial purposes (redevelop) ___ for other purposes.
b) In London, for example, the Docklands (transform) ___ since the 1980s.
c) The docks (build) ___ in the 19th century when London was a busy port, but by the 1980s, most business (lose) ___ and many docks (close)___.
d) This left large areas of derelict land, and many people without jobs.
e) Since the 1980s, £10 billion ($17 billion) (spend) ___ on the project.
f) 600 hectares of derelict land (improve) ___, 9 km of new roads (build) ___, 80,000 new jobs (create) ___ and 24,000 new homes (construct)___.

narr: Bu mashqda shahar rivoji bilan bog'li matnni to'ldirishimiz kerak.
Ko'rib turganingizdek, ba'zi fe'llar present perfect passive da, ba'zilari esa past perfect passive da ishlatilishi kerak.
Doklar qurilgan, bizness yo'qolgan va doklar yopilgan - bu barchasi 1980-yillardan oldin sodir bo'lgan, shuning uchun ular past perfect passive (had been + past participle) da bo'ladi.
1980-yillardan keyin sodir bo'lgan barcha narsalar esa present perfect passive (has/have been + past participle) da bo'ladi.
Masalan, 'the Docklands has been transformed' yoki '£10 billion has been spent'.

data.heading: 5-mashq — Shahar rivoji (cont.)
steps: g) In addition to this, 100,000 new trees (plant) ___ and 130 hectares of parks (create)___.
h) Cultural venues such as the Docklands Arena (open)___.
i) Some local people do not agree with all the things that (do) ___, as houses here are expensive, and most jobs are in media, IT or business.
j) On the other hand, a declining area of the city (give) ___ a new lease of life.
data.result: a) have been redeveloped; b) has been transformed; c) had been built, had been lost, had been closed; d) This left large areas of derelict land, and many people without jobs.; e) has been spent; f) have been improved, have been built, have been created, have been constructed; g) have been planted, have been created; h) has been opened; i) has been done; j) has been given.

narr: Keyingi mashqlarda biz gaplarni passiv holatga o'tkazamiz, lekin bu safar 'someone' yoki 'people' so'zlarisiz.
Bu usulda harakat qiluvchi emas, balki harakat qilinayotgan narsa gapning boshiga keladi.

data.heading: 6A-mashq — Someone yoki people so'zlarisiz qayta yozish
data.problem: Har bir gapni someone yoki people so'zlari qatnashmaydigan qilib qayta yozing:
steps: b. Someone constructed a hot-air balloon in 1783.
c. People developed the steam ship in the 19th century.
d. Someone opened the first successful passenger railway in 1830.
e. People started the first passenger airlines after the First World War.
data.result:
b) A hot-air balloon was constructed in 1783.
c) The steam ship was developed in the 19th century.
d) The first successful passenger railway was opened in 1830.
e) The first passenger airlines were started after the First World War.

narr: Bu mashqda biz 'someone' yoki 'people' so'zlarisiz gaplarni passiv holatga o'tkazamiz.
Masalan, 'Someone constructed a hot-air balloon' degan gapni 'A hot-air balloon was constructed' deb yozishimiz kerak.
Bu erda harakat qiluvchi emas, balki harakat qilinayotgan narsa - 'hot-air balloon' gapning boshiga keladi.
Xuddi shu tarzda barcha javoblar berilgan.

data.heading: 6B-mashq — Vositachi 'by' bilan qayta yozish
data.problem: Har bir gapni vositachi 'by' qatnashadigan qilib qayta yozing:
steps: f. The Chinese probably printed the first books more than a thousand years ago.
g. The Remington company sold the first modern typewriters in the 1870s.
h. Edison recorded the first words on a gramophone record in 1877.
i. The Lumière brothers created the first modern cinema in France in 1895.
j. Valdemar Poulsen invented the tape recorder in 1899.
data.result:
f) The first books were probably printed by the Chinese more than a thousand years ago.
g) The first modern typewriters were sold by the Remington company in the 1870s.
h) The first words on a gramophone record were recorded by Edison in 1877.
i) The first modern cinema was created by the Lumière brothers in France in 1895.
j) The tape recorder was invented by Valdemar Poulsen in 1899.

narr: Bu mashqda biz 'by' vositachisiz gaplarni passiv holatga o'tkazamiz.
Bu usulda kim harakat qilgani ham ko'rsatiladi.
Masalan, 'The Chinese printed the first books' degan gapni 'The first books were printed by the Chinese' deb yozishimiz kerak.
Bu erda 'by the Chinese' qismi kim harakat qilganini ko'rsatadi.
Xuddi shu tarzda barcha javoblar berilgan.
6-haftada biz grafiklar va diagrammalarni tushunishga o'rganamiz.
Shuningdek, qisqa nutqlarni eshitish va tahlil qilish usullarini ko'rib chiqamiz.
Bugungi kunda grafiklar ma'lumotlarni vizual ravishda taqdim etishning muhim usuli hisoblanadi.

data.heading: Diagramma turlari
bullets: Diagrammalar — ma'lumotlarni ixcham ko'rinishda taqdim etishning vizual usullari. Ular ko'pincha figures deb ham ataladi. Akademik maqolada ular odatda Fig. (Figure) 1, Fig. 2 va hokazo deb belgilanadi.
Pie chart (sektorli diagramma) — umumiy summa qanday bo'linishini ko'rsatish uchun markazdan chiquchi sektordan iborat diagramma.

narr: Grafiklarni tushunishning birinchi qadami turli xil diagramma turlarini bilishdir.
Eng keng tarqalgan diagramma turlari orasida sektorli diagramma (pie chart) bor.
Ushbu turdagi diagramma butun miqdorning qismlarga bo'linishini ko'rsatadi.
Masalan, bir mamlakat byudjetining qanday qismlari ta'limga, sog'liqni saqlashga va boshqa sohalar ajratilganini ko'rsatishi mumkin.
